summary: The filing reports the appointment of Dr. Corazon (Corsee) Sanders to the board of Calidi Biotherapeutics, effective June 17, 2026. No departure, forced removal, or abrupt change is disclosed. Terms are limited to board service and audit committee membership. No consideration, premium, or stakeholder vote is involved. This is a routine board appointment, not a special situation. The registrant is the issuer. Watch for any subsequent material changes, but this filing alone lacks special-situation significance.
